heading: M Family Modular Microprocessor Relays - Legacy

text: The M Family is a new generation of modular microprocessor protective relays based on a common platform. The M Family offers a competitive solution that combines protection, monitoring, widely accepted communications standards, and flexible configuration tools for many applications. Each product within the M Family may be used as a stand alone unit or as a component of an automated substation or industrial protection and control system.
